clinician_fields.label: Visit
clinician_fields.help: Date, mode, length, language of the session, and whether an interpreter was used. The system fills in the times; you confirm.
clinician_fields.measure: equity by language; time to counselling

clinician_fields.label: When the result was released
clinician_fields.help: Filled in by the system from the pathway record.

clinician_fields.label: Findings discussed
clinician_fields.help: Tick each finding that was discussed. Mark whether it was explained as a chance and not a diagnosis, and whether it was uncertain.
clinician_fields.anchor: PRSB 9.5.3: unconfirmed or excluded diagnoses are not coded as diagnoses
clinician_fields.measure: links the result to the counselling

clinician_fields.label: Information given
clinician_fields.help: Tick each point that was explained.

clinician_fields.label: Choices discussed
clinician_fields.help: Tick each choice that was described. Choices are listed in a fixed neutral order. None is recommended.
clinician_fields.anchor: PRSB 9.15.3 shared decision making; challenge item 2
clinician_fields.measure: informed choice; options in a neutral order

clinician_fields.label: Teach-back
clinician_fields.help: Did the couple explain the result back in their own words? Record how accurate it was.
clinician_fields.anchor: teach-back method (AHRQ Health Literacy Universal Precautions Toolkit, Tool 5; secondary source)

clinician_fields.label: Questions
clinician_fields.help: Were questions invited, and were they answered?

clinician_fields.label: Plan
clinician_fields.help: Each action has an owner and a due date.
clinician_fields.anchor: PRSB 9.15.1: the plan names who owns each action
clinician_fields.measure: the actions that become referral tasks

clinician_fields.label: Referral tasks
clinician_fields.help: Filled in by the system from the referral tasks.
clinician_fields.measure: completion; time to referral; lost-task count

clinician_fields.label: Future services
clinician_fields.help: The person's own opt-in answer. Filled in by the person, not by you.

clinician_fields.label: Sharing and consent
clinician_fields.help: Whether a copy was given to the patient. The system adds the consent record.

clinician_fields.label: Completed by
clinician_fields.help: Filled in by the system: your role and the time.

patient_items.prompt: In your own words, what does this result mean for the two of you?
patient_items.measures: teach-back comprehension (to be coded 0, 1 or 2 against a fixed rubric by two raters in a later study)

patient_items.prompt: Out of 100 pregnancies of couples with this same result, about how many children would have the condition?
Being a carrier means the person has the disease.
If the test found nothing shared, our children cannot have any inherited condition.
What is the next step, and who is responsible for it?

options.counsellor_explains: A counsellor or doctor explains the result and the choices to us
options.centre_decides: The screening centre decides for us

patient_items.prompt: I know what matters most to us when choosing what to do next.
I felt free to choose. Nobody pushed us in a direction.

sils_prompt: How often do you need to have someone help you when you read instructions, pamphlets, or other written material from your doctor or pharmacy?
sils_attribution: Question from the Single Item Literacy Screener (Morris and others), used under a CC BY licence. This wording is an unvalidated draft.
service_interest_prompt: Would you like information about services for planning a pregnancy?
service_interest_consent_text: We can send you information about services for planning a pregnancy when you are ready. For example: counselling before pregnancy, testing for a partner or relatives, and options for starting a family. This is your choice. Your answer does not change your result. It is not shown to your partner, family, employer or insurer through this service, and we do not record whether you plan to marry. You can say not now or no thank you, and you can change your mind at any time. If you say yes, we use only the contact method you choose, and only to send this information.

service_interest_topics.partner_or_relative_testing: Testing for a partner or relatives
service_interest_topics.conception_options_information: Information about options for starting a family
